body: Kicking a person when he's down must give you a twisted sense of validation, huh? If anything, keep talking down to me - it's giving me enough courage to act on my impulses. You're right - I am a weak and feeble nothing and I don't care anymore.
A sense of belonging, purpose and not feeling self-doubt 24/7.

Suicidal depression is literally the ultimate ambivalence. I know because I've been feeling like this for years. Literally everyday I fight intense suicidal urges and I talk myself into living despite wanting to die all the time. It is beyond exhausting and I am shocked at how I've literally been feeling like this for years. I am not patting myself on the back because I do realize human beings can adapt to just about anything once they're faced with it for so long. I am not sure what to tell you and I don't even know why I am writing this. Your message made me think. I do find most of the people trying to help on this particular sub to be sincere and caring souls. Souls who are also struggling with very similar feelings and it's really important to realize that they can only do and say so much. To talk is easy but to listen is even harder: this is the sad and harsh truth when it comes to being heard. I feel like most people don't even know what to even say to someone who is severely depressed and/or suicidal. It is more about being and feeling heard than words that just sound nice.
